simple.meaning: דִּיג (dîyg) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to fish.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Jeremiah, beginning at Jeremiah 16:16. The surrounding contexts include mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דִּיג (H1770) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: דִּיג (dîyg) / H1770 is traced through Jeremiah 16:16 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: “Behold, I will send for many fishermen,” says Yahweh, “and they will fish them up. Afterward I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain, from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.
